title: Auralis corpus manifest entry
description: One entry of corpus/manifest.json: one audio clip of the golden corpus, its licence and its annotations. The manifest itself is a JSON array of entries, each validated against this schema.

id.description: Unique identifier of the clip; lowercase, no spaces.

file.description: Path of the audio file relative to the corpus directory, forward slashes only.

licence.description: SPDX identifier of the licence of the clip. CC0-1.0 and the MIT/BSD/Apache family are permissive. The CC-BY-NC and CC-BY-NC-SA families are research only and must never be redistributed with a product.

source_url.description: URL the clip was downloaded from, or the literal string "synthesised" for the clips that corpus/build_corpus.py generates in the repository.

source_credit.description: Name to print in the attribution file.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the file in Hz.

channels.description: Number of channels of the file.

duration_s.description: Duration of the clip in seconds.

sha256.description: Checksum of the audio file, so the corpus can be verified.

tags.description: Free-form labels for searching the corpus.

events.description: The events of the clip. Intervals are half open: [start_s, end_s). Events may overlap.

levels.description: The ground truth of the clip: the measured levels in dBFS (or the named unit of the key) of everything the clip contains. Keys that do not apply to the clip are omitted.

peak_dbfs.description: Largest absolute sample of the clip, in dBFS.

rms_dbfs.description: RMS of the mono mix, in dBFS.

total_rms_dbfs.description: RMS of the whole multi channel signal, in dBFS.

rt60_s.description: Reverberation time of the clip, in seconds.

bit_depth.description: Bit depth of the stored file.

positions.description: Extra ground truth positions, each a [start_s, end_s) pair - for example the sample runs that sit at full scale.

regions.description: Named measurement regions of the clip, each a [start_s, end_s] pair in seconds - for example the window a reverberation time is measured in.

mix.description: The signal a measurement of the clip is taken on: the mono mix, the mid, the side or one channel.

bands.description: The ground truth of the frequency bands of the clip: the level a band measurement returns, with the band edges, the window and the signal the measurement is taken on.

band_hz.description: Edges of the band, as a [low_hz, high_hz] pair.

region_s.description: Window the band is measured in, as a [start_s, end_s] pair.

mix.description: The signal the band is measured on.

level_dbfs.description: Level of the band, in dBFS.

min_excess_db.description: How much louder the band has to be inside its window than outside it. The check is a lower bound: the band inside the window minus the band outside it has to be at least this large.

frequencies.description: The ground truth of the frequencies of the clip: the frequency of the strongest partial of the clip inside the search band, measured over the window on the named signal. A null frequency means that the clip holds no partial at all.

hz.description: The frequency of the partial, in hertz; null when the clip holds no partial.

method.description: How the frequency is measured: peak (the strongest partial of the search band) or centroid (the centre of mass of the power spectrum of the search band).

region_s.description: Window the frequency is measured in, as a [start_s, end_s] pair.

mix.description: The signal the frequency is measured on.

search_hz.description: The band the partial is looked for in, as a [low_hz, high_hz] pair.

tolerance_hz.description: How far the measured frequency may be from the declared one, in hertz.

phase.description: The ground truth of the relation between the two channels: the phase of the right channel relative to the left one and the correlation of the two.

degrees.description: The phase of the right channel relative to the left one, in degrees, in (-180, 180].

correlation.description: The correlation of the two channels: +1 identical, -1 opposite, 0 uncorrelated.

region_s.description: Window the phase is measured in, as a [start_s, end_s] pair.

tolerance_deg.description: How far the measured phase may be from the declared one, in degrees.

tolerance_correlation.description: How far the measured correlation may be from the declared one.

derived.description: The ground truth of a figure that is the difference of two measured ones: the signal-to-noise ratio of a voice over a hiss, the distance between two band levels.

tolerance.description: How far the measured figure may be from the declared one, in decibels.

terms.description: The measured figures the derived one is the sum of. A term names either a level of annotations.levels or a band of annotations.bands, and carries the sign it is added with.

key.description: The level of annotations.levels the term is.

band.description: The band of annotations.bands the term is.

sign.description: The sign the term is added with; 1 by default.

event.description: One annotated event inside a clip.

type.description: Controlled vocabulary of the event kinds.

start_s.description: Start of the event in seconds, relative to the first sample of the file.

end_s.description: End of the event in seconds (exclusive).

label.description: Short human readable description of the event. Not a key, never parsed by the tests.

amplitude_dbfs.description: Level of the event itself, in dBFS. Ground truth for a synthesised event.

center_hz.description: Centre frequency of the event, in Hz. Ground truth for a synthesised event.

band_hz.description: Frequency band of the event, as a [low_hz, high_hz] pair.
